items.title: WMG and Spotify talk AI remixes and the need for artist consent
items.excerpt: At Morgan Stanley's European TMT conference, Warner Music Group and Spotify executives discussed AI remix features and the need for artist consent before fans can remix or transform tracks with AI.

history_match.title: Spotify Reportedly Set to Debut AI Cover & Remix Tool in Early '27

items.title: Agentic AI in music marketing: 'superhumans', safeguards and 7am inbox briefs
items.excerpt: Music marketers describe moving from chatbot Q&A to agentic AI workflows - automated morning briefs, campaign agents and the safeguards labels are putting around them.

items.title: A.I.Radio includes 'a DJ you can talk to and request songs from'
items.excerpt: A new radio app, A.I.Radio, pairs streaming stations with an AI DJ that listeners can talk to and ask for song requests.

items.title: "If you can't defeat it, you have to join it": Peter Gabriel makes his stance on AI clear
items.excerpt: Peter Gabriel reaffirms his AI-aligned vision of the future, arguing musicians should engage with AI tools rather than try to defeat them (from his Guardian interview).

items.title: Grimes Releases Two New Psy Opera Songs
items.excerpt: Grimes shared 'Deepseek' and 'Killing God With Computers' from her AI-themed album Psy Opera; 'Deepseek' is the only track to actually use AI, adapted from a poem generated with the DeepSeek LLM.

items.title: Eminem Publisher Eight Mile Style Files Amended Suno Copyright and DMCA Suit, Adding 100+ Allegedly Infringing Outputs
items.excerpt: Eight Mile Style has filed an amended complaint against Suno adding DMCA and name/likeness claims and more than 100 allegedly infringing AI outputs echoing 'Lose Yourself' and 'Without Me'.

history_match.title: Elvis Presley Enterprises and Authentic Brands Group file amended, expanded Suno copyright and NIL suit

items.title: How many streams are AI tracks actually generating on DSPs? (They Aren't Listening: roughly 87% of tracks never streamed)
items.excerpt: New distributor data shared with DMN shows machine-generated tracks rack up far fewer streams and fans than their upload volume suggests; of ~300M tracks on DSPs only ~40M have a single stream.

items.title: Universal Music Lambasts 'Walled Garden' Criticism as 'A Complete Flip of Reality'
items.excerpt: UMG's Michael Nash defends keeping gen-AI outputs inside licensed 'walled garden' platforms rather than on Spotify/Apple Music, and says the label is pursuing artist opt-ins at scale for upcoming gen-AI products.

items.title: Michael Rapino talks Live Nation's AI strategy; Ticketmaster building its own AI 'fan agent'
items.excerpt: At Live Nation's investor day, Ticketmaster said it is building its own AI 'fan agent' and won't hand checkout to AI platforms; Rapino argued live music is less exposed to AI than labels.

items.title: Tencent Music says AI content streams are 'negligible' - as it takes legal action over AI infringement
items.excerpt: Tencent Music Entertainment told investors AI-generated content is a negligible and declining share of streams on its platforms, and that it is taking legal action over AI infringement.

items.title: Hive Launches AI Assistants to Help Venues and Promoters Sell More Tickets
items.excerpt: Hive's new AI assistants automate preparation of email and SMS campaigns for live-event marketers, freeing time for strategy and creative work.

items.title: The Show Before the Show: How AI Can Help Build More Profitable Music Tours
items.excerpt: AI-powered forecasting and routing-optimization tools can help artists and promoters plan more profitable tours before a ticket is sold.

items.title: Anukari 1.1 now available
items.excerpt: The 3D physics-modelling synth adds strings, plates, tubes and a blowable mouthpiece, plus new compatibility with AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT so users can build patches via prompts.

items.title: Sonic Palette: Predicting Dynamic Color Themes from Music
items.excerpt: A music-conditioned autoregressive Transformer predicts frame-wise five-colour palettes from audio, modelling how visual colour themes evolve over time in response to music.

items.title: Harmonic Circuit: Chord Progression Lies in a Sparse Principal Information Flow in Symbolic Music Models
items.excerpt: Mechanistic-interpretability study identifies a sparse circuit in ChatMusician and MuPT that drives prediction of the tonic root in cadences.

items.title: [인&아웃] AI가 부른 1위곡, 주인은 누구인가
items.excerpt: 실존하지 않는 AI 가수의 노래가 멜론 정상에 오른 뒤 저작권과 수익 귀속 문제를 짚은 칼럼.
